messages:
nina_sales: Heads up - Orbitix Labs asked for a one-time invoice adjustment and extended terms. They say we charged them migration support twice on INV-2026-0612. Can finance approve a credit + short Net terms?
omar_finance: What amount are they requesting? Any contract clause covering migration credits?
nina_sales: They uploaded receipts showing duplicate line for $6,400. Requesting full $6.4k credit + Net45 for next invoice while they finish PO.
claire_fpna: Discretionary credit threshold is $5k without director signoff. >$5k needs CFO or director approval. Also Net45 increases DSO; AR must agree.
raj_legal: We can do one-time credit; will require customer acknowledgement that this is final. No SLA or subscription changes.
billing-bot: Retrieved INV-2026-0612 lines:
```
Service: Migration Support - 2x entries @ $6,400 each
Usage: Dedicated GPUs = $9,600
Tax: $320
Total: $22,720
```
omar_finance: Given it's $6,400, need director sign-off. Claire, can you escalate?
claire_fpna: I can approve $6,400 if sales agrees to waive any future retro claims and we get a signed acknowledgement. Approving Net45 for next invoice only.
nina_sales: I'll get the signed ack and confirm. Orbitix is a small but strategic pilot - they accept the conditions.
raj_legal: I'll paste a one-line acknowledgement for Nina to request: "We acknowledge receipt of a one-time credit of $6,400 to INV-2026-0612; this resolves the billing dispute in full and is non-recurring."
billing-bot: Action: prepare credit memo CM-2026-067 for $6,400 pending customer_ack_orbitix_2026-03-05.eml.
omar_finance: Approved (internal): issue CM-2026-067 for $6,400; Net45 for next invoice. Please attach customer ack and mark Deal Desk entry DDK-2026-118.
nina_sales: Sent to Orbitix and received signed reply. Uploading to Deal Desk now.
billing-bot: CM-2026-067 created and queued. Will apply after receipt of customer_ack_orbitix_2026-03-05.eml.
claire_fpna: Documented: credit approved $6,400, Net45 x1, file DDK-2026-118. Closing thread after CM applied.
nina_sales: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
